items.title: Kyoto vs Osaka
items.task: Walk one busy street. Tick what feels true: louder, brighter, funnier, messier, more food, more shops.
items.reveal: No right mix. Osaka likes to show off. Kyoto likes manners. Both are stereotypes. Check them against the street.

items.title: Kitchen of Japan
items.reveal: A merchant town. Rice, canals, then street food. ‘Kitchen of Japan’ is a nickname. Confirm the history wording before live.

items.title: Why Is Osaka Funny?
items.task: Listen for jokes, signs, or a comedy theatre. Osaka is famous for manzai: two people, quick talk.
